case: DuckDB ENUM raw CSV export/import round trip
contract: The local app contract exports DuckDB ENUM results using raw-text CSV and a collision-free explicit SQL NULL marker, then plans and executes a typed CSV import.
Empty text, the literal NULL label, Unicode, a quoted label, a formula-shaped label and SQL NULL retain their exact values and native ENUM type after import.
A pre-existing destination row is unchanged; native typeof, exact VARCHAR labels and the SQL NULL predicate provide the post-import oracle.
